UCL Careers events listing - summary (all figures are formulas over the 'All Sessions' sheet)
Source: UCL Careers 'Search events' listing (153 results), two PDF captures dated 13-Oct-2026 21:52/21:53.
One row per scheduled date; events offered on several dates (e.g. eCareersGrad MasterClasses) repeat with 'Session x of y'.
'Event Series / Programme' and 'Delivery Mode' are derived from the title and venue line respectively; all other fields are transcribed as listed.
'Delivery Mode' = 'Not stated' where the listing shows no venue/format line; 'In person (venue listed)' where a venue is given without an On/Off Campus label.
'Featured Organisation' records the sponsor logo shown beneath the description, where one appeared.
Day and Duration are formulas and recalculate if a date or time is edited.
